title: Sync implementation with draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00
description: Align kith implementation with the updated JMAP Chat I-D. The spec diverges from the current codebase in 7 areas: capability URI, Contact→ChatContact rename, ChatContact.id=userId, chat ID assignment model, participants→contactId, senderMsgId on Message, and senderTailscaleUserId→senderUserId. This epic tracks all alignment work.
